4 min read ↗

A few things, answered.

Are Manglo tools really free?

Yes. Every tool currently listed is free, with no account or subscription required. If we introduce a paid feature in the future, we will clearly label it.

Do you upload or store my images?

No. These image tools use your browser to process the files you choose. Images are not sent to a Manglo server. Closing or reloading the page clears your workspace.

Can I use the tools on my phone?

Yes, in a modern browser. Large photos may take longer on mobile devices. Each image is limited to 20 MB and 40 million pixels to protect browser memory.

Are the calculators specific to a marketplace?

No. Enter your own fees and costs. The results are estimates based on your inputs, not official marketplace quotes or tax advice.
